## Notes

**Quick read:** Tattooed mom in glasses with a blonde baby girl (about 10 to 14 months) filming in a teal living room with gothic decor; 1 approved video that ran in an ad but produced $0, and both scripts lean on "hands-free" and the summer sale.
**Best next move:** send her the first weekly inspo with a fresh non-sale angle and a clear note on one hand at all times, since both her videos show her arms up and off the baby.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: dark-haired mom with glasses, arm tattoos, grey graphic tee. Blonde baby girl roughly 10 to 14 months in a rainbow tee and jeans. Setting: her living room with teal walls, a tree-of-life wall piece and skeleton art, dark sofa, baby gate. Cotton Candy (pastel tie-dye) sling.
- Format: yapper reading a sales script to camera, 24 to 29 seconds, burned-in captions, fairly flat delivery with some dancing and arm waving. Hooks: "The Bambora Sling Carrier Summer Sale is still happening and if you've been waiting for an excuse to get one, let this be it", "Okay, if you've been eyeing the Bambora Sling Carrier, I have good news because their huge summer sale is still going on". Scripts read like a template (sale, patterns, thick padding, hands-free, click the link).
- What worked: 03243c3c approved and in 1 ad, but no spend or sales recorded yet ($0 GMV).
- Rejected: 9863bf06 (Aug 27), no review comment; frames show both arms raised overhead at 12s and an arm flung out at 8s, and the script says "completely hands-free".
- Safety and checklist: seat under her bottom and legs out looks right. Issues: the approved 03243c3c also says "still having hands-free" and at 25s she waves both hands (peace signs) with baby in the sling. Burned-in captions on both. Both are tied to a summer sale that has ended.
- Strengths: baby is adorable and calm, the tie-dye print pops on camera, she is willing to be playful.
- To improve: one hand on baby every frame; drop hands-free and sale scripts; talk in her own words about a real moment (the scripts sound read).
